name: Martian Manhunter
summary: The Justice League's quiet heart, with almost every power in the book. J'onn J'onzz, a Martian stranded on Earth, can shapeshift, read minds and phase through walls, but fire is his weak spot.
origin: J'onn J'onzz is the gentle soul of the Justice League and has nearly every superpower ever invented, which makes his loneliness hit even harder. Joseph Samachson and Joe Certa introduced him in Detective Comics #225 in 1955, when a scientist's experimental machine accidentally pulled him from Mars to Earth. Stranded, he took the human name John Jones and worked as a police detective. Later stories revealed he was the last survivor of his people. He is super strong and fast, can shapeshift, read minds, turn invisible, phase through walls and see far beyond human vision, but fire has always been his weakness. He helped found the Justice League, and he holds the team together more often than anyone admits.
powers: Sees across the full light spectrum

storyline.title: Stranded on Earth
storyline.beat: J'onn J'onzz is pulled from Mars to Earth by a scientist's experiment in Detective Comics #225. Stranded, he fights crime as police detective John Jones.

storyline.title: Founding member
storyline.beat: J'onn is one of the founding members of the Justice League of America.

storyline.title: The heart of the team
storyline.beat: In the comedic Justice League International, J'onn is the team's steady centre and grows famous for loving cookies.

storyline.title: Killed and returned
storyline.beat: J'onn is murdered by the villain Libra at the start of Final Crisis, then brought back to life in Brightest Day.

gossip.text: He debuted in 1955, a year before the Flash's Showcase #4, so some historians call him the first Silver Age superhero.
His love of Oreo cookies became a running gag in the comics, later renamed Chocos.
He fought crime under the cover name John Jones, a police detective.

timeline.title: Stranded on Earth
timeline.note: Detective Comics #225 has a scientist's experiment yank J'onn J'onzz from Mars, so he hides out as a detective.

timeline.title: Founding member
timeline.note: J'onn is part of the first Justice League lineup in The Brave and the Bold #28.

timeline.title: Heart of the JLI
timeline.note: The relaunched, comedy-tinged Justice League makes J'onn the calm centre of a bickering new roster.

timeline.title: Animated anchor
timeline.note: Carl Lumbly voices J'onn in the Justice League cartoon, nailing his quiet, mournful dignity.

timeline.title: Final Crisis opener
timeline.note: Final Crisis #1 starts with J'onn murdered by the villain Libra, a shock first move in DC's big event.

timeline.title: Brightest Day
timeline.note: The white light at the end of Blackest Night brings J'onn back to life and into the Brightest Day saga.

timeline.title: Supergirl's guardian
timeline.note: David Harewood plays J'onn on TV's Supergirl, hiding in plain sight as a government agent watching over Kara.
